pages.en:
White Russian
Youths Ousted
From Tientsin

(Reuters)
TIENTSIN, Oct. 15.—Somewhat
of a sensation was created by a
quarter-page bold-type announce-
ment appearing in this morning's
Russian newspapers revoking the
permits of certain White Russian
youths to reside in Tientsin, pre-
sumably for disobeying the orders of
the local Russian Anti-Communist
Committee to, register for military
training.

The announcement read: "The
Police headquarters of Greater
Tientsin hereby announces for
general information that (here a
list of 11 White Russian youths
among the first batch of conscripts
called up for registration is given)
from Oct. 14 of the current year are
deprived of the right of residence in
Tientsin territory, and residential
permits issued to them by the
Public Safety Bureau are hereby
declared null and void."

The announcement was signed by
Commissioner of the Chinese Police
Bureau of Greater Tientsin, General
Yen Chia-chi.

It is understood that the lads were
not arraigned before a law court
prior to the present banishment
announcement.

The list includes two Hramzoff
lads, whose father was detained for
24 hours by the White House—head-
quarters of the Committee—last
month when his sons failed to pre-
sent themselves for registration as
ordered.

（批：8/16 10 H）
pages.zh:
白俄青年
被逐出天津

（路透社）
天津，10月15日电。——今晨俄文报纸上刊登的一则占四分之一版面的粗体字公告引起了一些轰动，该公告撤销了某些白俄青年在天津的居留许可，推测原因是他们违抗了当地俄国反共委员会关于登记参加军事训练的命令。

公告写道：“天津特别市警察总局特此公告如下，以供周知：（此处列出了第一批被征召登记中的11名白俄青年名单）自本年10月14日起，被剥夺在天津地域内的居留权，发给他们的公安局居留证 hereby 宣布无效。”

该公告由天津特别市中国警察局总监严家炽将军签署。

据悉，在这些青年被驱逐之前，并未将他们提交法庭审讯。

名单中包括两名 Hramzoff 家的青年，他们的父亲上个月因儿子们未按命令前来登记，被白屋（委员会总部）拘留了24小时。

（批注：8/16 10 H）

pages.en:
Exiled Russians in Shanghai
Rally to Aid Fatherland

EXILED Russians in Shanghai today feel the danger of their beloved Fatherland being overrun by the Nazi hordes. A people without home because of their political differences, the White Russians in Shanghai have nearly all joined hands to do their bit for their country.

There is no longer the cry of "down with Bolshevism" but rather "down with the Nazis!" Only a small group of exiled Russians in this city believe that they will be able to benefit by the war conducted by Hitler and his henchmen. Daily this group is becoming smaller in number and it is believed that in the near future such an element will cease to exist in Shanghai.

Once strongly boycotted by the White Russian community here, Soviet films are now drawing huge crowds of these same people. Shown in only one theatre in Shanghai, tickets for U.S.S.R. productions are sold out in advance.

Tremendous ovations are given by the audience when Soviet military and political leaders are projected on the screen. Even wilder outbursts of enthusiasm greet scenes of Russian life and the progress the Soviets have made in the rebuilding of important cities in Russia. The reception given by the Russian community in Shanghai to Soviet films is but one example of the change of feeling.

The Soviet Red Cross Fund, which was originated only a short while ago in Shanghai, is a striking illustration of the patriotic feeling displayed by the Russians in the city. Hardest hit by the present living conditions, these people contribute everything possible within their means in order to swell the coffers of the organization.

Numerous exiled Russian officers who fought in the early days of the Revolution following Great War No. 1, have shelved their political beliefs, if only temporarily, and are urging their fellow countrymen to help their brothers and sisters in their battle against a common enemy.

The younger generation of Russians who were born in this city and educated in various schools, are nearly all waiting for a chance to strike a blow at the Nazi armies. Brought up in the shadows of the former greatness of Imperial Russia and following the Orthodox traditions preached in churches and clubs, these youthful girls and boys without a country today realize that their home is being threatened.

Soviet Citizens Increase

When recently it was learned that all Russians who wanted to obtain Soviet passports could do so, the Soviet Consulate in Tokyo was swamped by applications from local Russian residents. Those of the people who were granted U.S.S.R. citizenship considered themselves extremely lucky. Others, who were turned down, are waiting for a new chance to become people with a country once again. The die-hards who scorned the offer to becoming affiliated to their Fatherland while the Soviets ruled, are today feeling the urgency of the situation and are attempting to do their bit, no matter how small, in an effort to preserve all that they hold dear. The hatred towards the new system of rule in Russia has been replaced by a hatred towards Germany.

In nearly all Russian churches in Shanghai services have been held for the deliverance of the Fatherland from its enemy. The priests who conducted religious ceremonies when the Imperial Court held sway in Czarist Russia, today conduct the services in the same vein, but offer their humble prayers towards the destruction of the hated Nazi.

Prince Vsevolde's Letter

Prince Vsevolde of Russia recently sent a letter to "The Times" in London. The Prince wrote: "We are fighting a common foe and I feel that all Slav races should now unite to rid the world of Nazism." Mr. M. E. Sabline, a representative of the White Russian refugees in London, was another writer to "The Times" on the question.

By way of reply to the belief that religion is suppressed in the U.S.S.R. comes the news from Moscow that the churches were packed with people praying for the Russian fatherland and that the Patriarch is calling the people to defend their country.

This and other expressions of Soviet sentiment towards the Russian people in general, has played a major role in influencing the exiled Russian into forgetting their political creed and turning towards the defence of their home. The people today stand united in their efforts to destroy the threat to their country.

Nazi Attempts Fail

The attempt made by the Nazis to install a White Russian government which would one day rule Russia has failed. Hardly any support is given to the puppets of the Germans. In Shanghai only a very small group of people have any belief in the future functioning of these puppets and the activities of this group are limited in Nazi-occupied territory.

When the war against Russia first broke out, many local White Russians in Shanghai were under the belief that the chance to return to their country and install a member of the Imperial Family as ruler, had come. They expected that a revolution to overthrow the Soviets would take place. This was thought to be especially true in the Ukraine and Crimea. The heroic fighting by the Russian soldiers in these areas has shattered all such beliefs.

This turn of events has played a major role in the change of attitude by the local White Russians. These 30,000 or so exiles living in this city are showing in various ways their attitude towards Soviet Russia. Given a chance, these people would gladly die for their country. As it is, they are contributing in their own small way towards an ultimate victory over the Nazis.
pages.zh:
上海流亡俄国人集会援助祖国

上海的流亡俄国人今天感受到了他们挚爱的祖国被纳粹群魔 overrun 的危险。由于政治分歧而无家可归，上海的白俄几乎都联合起来，为他们的国家尽一份力。

不再有人高呼“打倒布尔什维克”，而是“打倒纳粹！”只有本市一小分流亡俄国人相信他们能够从希特勒及其爪牙进行的战争中获益。这一群体的人数每天都在减少，人们相信，在不久的将来，这类分子将在上海绝迹。

曾经遭到本地白俄社区强烈抵制的苏联电影，现在正吸引着大量同样的观众。在上海仅一家影院放映，苏联制作的电影票提前售罄。

当屏幕上出现苏联军事和政治领导人时，观众报以热烈的欢呼。而当出现俄国生活场景以及苏联在重建俄国重要城市方面取得的进展时，更是迎来了更为狂热的热情爆发。上海俄国社区对苏联电影的接受程度只是情感变化的一个例子。

不久前在上海发起的苏联红十字会基金，有力地说明了本市俄国人所表现出的爱国情怀。受当前生活条件打击最沉重的这些人，尽其所能捐款，以增加该组织的资金。

许多在第一次世界大战后的革命初期作战的流亡俄国军官，暂时搁置了他们的政治信仰，敦促同胞们帮助他们的兄弟姐妹对抗共同的敌人。

在本市出生并在各类学校受教育的年轻一代俄国人，几乎都在等待打击纳粹军队的机会。这些在昔日帝俄伟大的阴影下长大、遵循教堂和俱乐部中宣讲的正统传统的年轻男女，如今意识到他们的家园正受到威胁，尽管他们没有国家。

苏联公民增加

最近得知所有希望获得苏联护照的俄国人皆可申请后，驻东京苏联领事馆收到了来自本地俄国居民的大量申请。那些获准成为苏联公民的人觉得自己极其幸运。其他被拒绝的人则在等待新的机会，再次成为有国籍的人。那些在苏维埃统治时期蔑视与祖国建立联系提议的死硬派，今天感受到了局势的紧迫性，并试图尽自己的微薄之力，以保护他们所珍视的一切。对俄国新统治制度的仇恨已被对德国的仇恨所取代。

在上海几乎所有的俄国教堂里，都举行了祈求祖国从敌人手中解脱的礼拜仪式。在沙皇俄国宫廷掌权时主持宗教仪式的神父们，今天以同样的基调主持礼拜，但谦卑地祈祷摧毁可恨的纳粹。

弗谢沃洛德王子的信

俄国弗谢沃洛德王子（Prince Vsevolde）最近致信伦敦《泰晤士报》。王子写道：“我们正在对抗共同的敌人，我认为所有斯拉夫民族现在应该团结起来，清除世界上的纳粹主义。” M. E. Sabline 先生是伦敦白俄难民的代表，他就此问题也致信《泰晤士报》。

针对认为苏联压制宗教的看法，来自莫斯科的消息称，教堂里挤满了为俄国祖国祈祷的人们，且牧首正在号召人民保卫国家。

这种以及其他表达苏联对一般俄国人民情感的举动，在促使流亡俄国人忘记其政治信条并转向保卫家园方面发挥了主要作用。今天，人们在努力消除对国家威胁的行动中团结一致。

纳粹企图失败

纳粹建立一个终有一天将统治俄国的白俄政府的企图已经失败。几乎没有人支持德国的傀儡。在上海，只有极少数人相信这些傀儡未来的运作，且该群体的活动局限于纳粹占领区。

当对俄战争最初爆发时，上海许多本地白俄认为，返回祖国并拥立一位皇室成员为统治者的机会已经到来。他们预期会发生推翻苏维埃的革命。人们认为这在乌克兰和克里米亚尤其如此。俄国士兵在这些地区的英勇战斗粉碎了所有这些信念。

这一事态转折在当地白俄态度的改变中发挥了主要作用。居住在本市的约30,000名流亡者正以各种方式展示他们对苏维埃俄国的态度。如果有机会，这些人将乐于为国捐躯。事实上，他们正以自己的微薄之力，为最终战胜纳粹做出贡献。

OUR STRENGTH GROWS!

With a feeling of a profound satisfaction we publish
in to-day's issue of our journal a brief report concerning the
meeting of the National Ideologic Centre in Shanghai, during
the course of which a number of important decisions were made.

Naturally, the main attention is attracted by the wish,
expressed by the Centre, to see Colonel N.K.SHLIJNIKOFF at the
post of Chairman of the Russian Emigrants Committee with Colo-
nel D.V. KOCHNEFF(1) and Mr. N.A. POKROVSKY as his Deputies.

We do not doubt that this wish will be taken into con-
sideration by the authorities on whom the approval of the no-
mination of Head of the Russian Emigrants Committee depends,
because this wish has been expressed by an organization uni-
fying in its ranks all active anti-communist elements of our
emigrant community.

This is the second time during the brief period of the
existence of the Ideologic Centre that it has adopted decisions
which will have a stabilizing effect on the life of the Russian
community and bring the community out of its state of confusion
first in political and now in social affairs. The fact alone
that these two decisions have been taken makes the Ideologic
Centre a very valuable organization destined to play and al-
ready playing an important part in our political and social
life.

The nature of these two decisions defines the course
of further activities of the Ideologic Centre. Unifying in
itself all our active anti-communist and anti-Soviet elements
the Ideologic Centre also steps on the path of a close coope-
ration with organizations and institutions which should carry
out and to a certain extent are already carrying out the work
comprising a part of the programme of the Ideologic Centre.
This in the first place applies to the Russian Emigrants Com-
mittee as a whole. As will be seen from the resolutions pas-
sed at the last meeting of the Centre, its activities may great-
ly benefit the work of the Financial-Economic, Registration and
Cultural-Educational Sections of the Russian Emigrants Commit-
tee. Close contact and cooperation with the Cultural-Educatio-
nal Section is especially important. In this respect the re-
solutions of the last meeting of the Centre open wide possibi-
lities for the carrying out of national-patriotic, cultural-
educational activities in the Russian emigrant community by
unified efforts of all active elements of the community.

And at present this front of the national-patriotic
work is the most important of our fronts. All forces should
be mobilized for service at this front and a plan should be
worked out for the guidance of their activities. They should
be unified by one will and one desire to defend and pro-
pagate always, everywhere and under every circumstances our
truth which, we firmly believe, is the truth by means of which
the Russian people will return to its glorious pre-revolutio-
nary historic and Christian past.

Our belief that communism will be destroyed in Russia

我们的力量在增长！

我们怀着深切的满意之情，在今日的期刊中刊登一份关于上海国家意识形态中心会议的简要报告，会议期间作出了一些重要决定。

自然，主要的关注点集中在该中心表达的一项愿望上，即希望N.K.什利日尼科夫（N.K. SHLIJNIKOFF）上校担任俄罗斯侨民委员会主席一职，并由D.V.科赫涅夫（D.V. KOCHNEFF）(1)上校和N.A.波克罗夫斯基（N.A. POKROVSKY）先生担任其副手。

我们毫不怀疑，这一愿望将得到当局的考虑，因为俄罗斯侨民委员会负责人的任命批准权取决于当局；而这一愿望是由一个团结了我们侨民社区中所有活跃的反共分子的组织所表达的。

这是意识形态中心在其短暂的存在期间第二次通过将对俄罗斯社区生活产生稳定作用、并使社区从政治乃至社会事务的混乱状态中走出来的决定。仅凭这两项决定得以通过这一事实，就使意识形态中心成为一个非常有价值的组织，注定要在我们的政治和社会生活中发挥——并且已经在发挥——重要作用。

这两项决定的性质界定了意识形态中心未来的活动方向。意识形态中心在自身内部团结了所有活跃的反共和反苏维埃分子，同时也踏上了与那些应当执行、且在某种程度上已经在执行构成意识形态中心纲领部分工作的组织和机构进行密切合作的道路。这首先适用于整个俄罗斯侨民委员会。从中心最近一次会议通过的决议可以看出，其活动将极大地惠及俄罗斯侨民委员会的财政经济处、登记处和文化教育处的工作。与文化教育处的密切联系与合作尤为重要。在这方面，中心最近一次会议的决议为通过社区所有活跃分子的统一努力，在俄罗斯侨民社区中开展民族爱国主义和文化教育活动开辟了广阔的可能性。

目前，这一民族爱国主义工作战线是我们最重要的战线。所有力量都应动员起来服务于这一战线，并应制定计划以指导其活动。他们应由统一的意志和统一的愿望团结起来，即在任何时候、任何地方、任何情况下都要捍卫和传播我们的真理；我们坚信，正是凭借这一真理，俄罗斯人民将回归其光荣的革命前历史和基督教过去。

我们相信共产主义将在俄罗斯被摧毁

and our absolute conviction that the present events in our
native land will finally lead to the restoration of National
Russia, bind us into one anti-communist family, every member
of which should carry out a certain work in accordance with
the plan covering the activities of the whole family.

This plan provides for two general directions of
our social and political activities. The success and
effect of these activities depend on the coordination of the two
directions and keeping close and constant contact between
them, based on mutual confidence and support, because these
activities are based on unity of organization and thought.

Russian emigrants are a part of the body and soul
of the Russian people. All that is said about their alleged
inability of unification in the interests of a common cause
is absurd. The right time has arrived - and the unity required
has been achieved.

We are firmly convinced that very soon all the
pessimists and enemies of Russian emigrants will see for
themselves what unified Russian emigrants can achieve.

Our strength is growing because we are unified by
a common will to gain victory over our enemy and the enemy
of the entire humanity.

以及我们绝对确信祖国当前的事件最终将导致民族俄罗斯的恢复，这些信念将我们结合成一个反共家庭，其中的每个成员都应根据涵盖整个家庭活动的计划执行某些工作。

该计划规定了我们的社会和政治活动的两个总体方向。这些活动的成功和效果取决于这两个方向的协调，以及基于相互信任和支持的保持密切和持续的联系，因为这些活动建立在组织和思想的统一基础之上。

俄罗斯侨民是俄罗斯人民身体和灵魂的一部分。所有关于他们 alleged 无法为了共同事业而统一的说法都是荒谬的。正确的时机已经到来——所需的统一已经实现。

我们 firmly 相信，很快所有的悲观主义者和俄罗斯侨民的敌人都将亲眼看到统一的俄罗斯侨民能够取得什么成就。

我们的力量正在增长，因为我们被战胜我们的敌人以及全人类的敌人的共同意志所统一。

COLONEL N.K. ORLOVNIKOF, NOMINATED FOR POST OF
CHAIRMAN OF RUSSIAN EMIGRANTS COMMITTEE WITH
COLONEL D.V. KOCHNEFF AND MR. N.A. POKROVSKY AS
HIS DEPUTIES

Meeting of Plenary Council of National-Ideologic Centre
in Shanghai

On Thursday, October 9, 1941, a meeting of the Plenary
Council (1) of the National-Ideologic Centre in Shanghai was
held in the premises of the Cossacks Union

Representatives of all organizations comprising the
Ideologic Centre, as well as a number of individual public and
political workers from the local emigrant community, who
received personal invitations, attended.

The meeting was opened by Major-General GOVOROFF,
Vice-President of the Ideologic Centre, on whose suggestion those
present rose to pay respect to the memory of the late Mr. N.A.
IVANOFF, Chairman of the Russian Emigrants Committee. In his
opening speech General GOVOROFF pointed out the seriousness and
importance of the tasks, for the carrying out which the
Ideologic Centre had been created and which it is carrying out
to the best of its abilities and in accordance with the general
desire to render useful service to the cause of liberation of
our Motherland from the communist rule.

The agenda of the meeting, worked out by the Standing
Council (2) of the Centre, were then approved, as well as the
proposal of the Fascist Union and Union of Cossacks to include
in the agenda the question of nomination of a candidate for the
post of chairman of the Russian Emigrants Committee.

This was followed by a report of Colonel ELSNER,
Secretary of the Ideologic Centre, on the work done by the
Standing Council. He pointed out that the declaration of the
National-Ideologic Centre had been translated into foreign
languages, that several thousands of printed copies of the
declaration had been distributed to all Russian and foreign
institutions and organizations. Apart from this, the
declaration had been sent to all diplomatic and administrative
institutions in Shanghai. Furthermore, in addition to and in
elucidation of the declaration in question, a number of articles
had been published in local newspapers by members of the
Ideologic Centre, among which the most valuable were contributed
by Colonel VEDENIAPIN. Continuing, Colonel ELSNER said that
a programme of activities had been carefully worked out by the
Standing Council and would be carried out into effect as soon
as it was approved by the Plenary Council.

Having unanimously approved Colonel ELSNER'S report
the meeting proceeded with the discussion of the questions on
the agenda. The following resolutions were passed :-

(1) That the proposal of the Standing Council regarding
the organization of publication of pamphlets and
other propaganda material of anti-communist nature,
as well as of the holding of lectures, addresses
etc. be approved.

上海国家意识形态中心全体理事会会议

1941年10月9日星期四，上海国家意识形态中心全体理事会(1)会议在哥萨克联盟的办公地点举行。

组成意识形态中心的所有组织的代表，以及收到个人邀请的当地侨民社区中的一批公共和政治工作者出席了会议。

会议由意识形态中心副主席戈沃罗夫（GOVOROFF）少将主持开幕，在他的提议下，与会者起立向已故的俄罗斯侨民委员会主席N.A.伊万诺夫（N.A. IVANOFF）先生致敬。戈沃罗夫将军在开幕致辞中指出，创建意识形态中心旨在执行的任务具有严肃性和重要性，该中心正尽其所能，并按照为我们祖国从共产主义统治下解放出来这一事业提供有益服务的一般愿望来执行这些任务。

随后，会议批准了由中心常任理事会(2)制定的会议议程，以及法西斯联盟和哥萨克联盟提出的将提名俄罗斯侨民委员会主席候选人一事列入议程的提议。

接着，意识形态中心秘书埃尔斯特纳（ELSNER）上校就常任理事会所做的工作作了报告。他指出，国家意识形态中心的宣言已被翻译成外文，数千份印刷版的宣言已分发给所有俄罗斯和外国机构及组织。此外，该宣言已发送给上海的所有外交和行政机构。 furthermore，除了该宣言本身及其阐释外，意识形态中心成员还在当地报纸上发表了一系列文章，其中最有价值的是由韦杰尼亚平（VEDENIAPIN）上校撰写的文章。埃尔斯特纳上校继续说道，常任理事会已仔细制定了活动计划，一旦获得全体理事会批准，将立即付诸实施。

在一致批准埃尔斯特纳上校的报告后，会议 proceeded 对议程上的问题进行了讨论。通过了以下决议：-

(1) 批准常任理事会关于组织出版小册子和其他反共性质的宣传材料，以及举办讲座、演讲等的提议。

(6) 要求俄罗斯侨民委员会从侨民队伍中开除所有公开为苏维埃政府利益工作的人，即：在布尔什维克报刊和亲苏广播电台工作的人，或向苏维埃机构捐款的人，或经常光顾苏维埃俱乐部的人，或参加援助红军等的慈善音乐会的人。此类被开除人员的名单将在远东各地的俄罗斯民族报刊上公布。

(7) 呼吁俄罗斯侨民社区，请求其成员通过定期向侨民委员会的自愿自我征税基金捐款，以履行对社区的道德义务，该基金用于俄罗斯学校、医院、公共食堂以及各种贫困和老年人收容所的需求。

" FOR RUSSIA "

Re-registration of Russian
emigrants.

It is high time to carry out an inspection of our emi-
grant ranks.
Shanghai being an international city, all sorts of out-
casts from the midst of national anti-communist emigrants are
active here under the mask of emigrants.
Foreigners, who generally, are ill informed on Russian af-
fairs, regard these people as representatives of Russian emi-
grants correctly expressing their feelings in connection with
the present Soviet-German war,
An emigrant is so called because he is politically oppos-
ed to the regime existing in Russia at present. On the contra-
ry the so-called partisans of defence of the U.S.S.R. and all
sorts of turn-coats have ,in the majority of cases, nothing
whatever in common with Russian anti-communist emigrants.
75% of Russian emigrants are composed of people who par-
ticipated in the armed struggle against their enemies and who,
in both the literal and figurative sense of the word, have not
laid down their arms. They true representatives of the anti-
communist masses, to disintegrate which the Comintern applies
every means and effort.
It is vitally essential to clarify and deepen all natio-
nal-political questions amongst Russian emigrants at present.
A roll-call and counting of active national elements are abso-
lutely imperative being dictated by life itself. This will ex-
pose all the dark elements who are still using emigrant pas-
ports as a cover for their activities.
All that indirectly benefits and supports the regime of
oppressors of Russia must be immediately cast out of the emi-
grant community. Once and for all anti-communist forces in
Shanghai must be clearly defined.
The Russian Emigrants Committee which is carrying out a
re-registration of local emigrants, should pay a very careful at-
tention to this task, with full understanding of its purpose
and importance, casting away all the bureaucratic methods and
negligence.
Our historical national flag is hoisted over the premi-
ses occupied by the offices of the Russian Emigrants Committee.
The presence of our national flag as an eternal symbol of Rus-
sia, makes it imperative to carry out a purge of emigrant ranks.
Not a single open or secret paid agent of the Bolsheviks should
be allowed to use this flag as a cover.
Furthermore, from the legal viewpoint the Russian Emi-
grants Committee is under the protection of the Nanking Govern-
ment, which is also engaged in the struggle against communism.
Consequently, all things considered, the re-registration should
not become a matter of a mere formality.
We think that upon completion of the re-registration the
Russian Emigrants Committee will publish in the national anti-
communist newspapers lists giving an accurate idea of the nu-
mber of anti-communist emigrants.
All emigrant institutions, societies and commercial enter-
prises registered with the Committee should be included in the
list in question. In one word - all that comprises the active

“为了俄罗斯”

俄国侨民重新登记。

是时候对我们的侨民队伍进行一次审查了。
上海是一座国际都市，各类被本国反共侨民群体所排斥的渣滓，正披着侨民的外衣在此活动。
外国人通常对俄国事务知之甚少，将这些人视为俄国侨民的代表，认为他们正确地表达了与当前苏德战争相关的情感。
所谓侨民，是指那些在政治上反对俄国现政权的人。相反，所谓的苏联保卫支持者以及各种变节分子，在大多数情况下，与俄国反共侨民毫无共同之处。
75%的俄国侨民由那些参与过武装斗争以对抗敌人、且在字面和比喻意义上均未放下武器的人组成。他们是反共群众的真正代表，而共产国际正不遗余力地试图瓦解这一群体。
目前，澄清并深化俄国侨民内部的所有民族政治问题至关重要。对活跃的民族分子进行点名和统计是生活本身所要求的绝对必要之举。这将揭露那些仍利用侨民护照作为活动掩护的黑暗分子。
所有间接惠及和支持俄国压迫者政权的事物，必须立即从侨民社群中清除。上海的反共力量必须一劳永逸地明确界定。
正在对本地侨民进行重新登记的俄国侨民委员会，应充分理解其目的和重要性，摒弃一切官僚主义方法和疏忽大意，对此任务予以高度重视。
我们历史的民族旗帜飘扬在俄国侨民委员会办公室所在的处所之上。
作为俄罗斯永恒象征的我们民族旗帜的存在，使得清洗侨民队伍成为当务之急。
绝不允许任何布尔什维克的公开或秘密受薪代理人利用这面旗帜作为掩护。
此外，从法律角度来看，俄国侨民委员会受南京政府的保护，该政府也从事反共斗争。
因此，综合各方面考虑，重新登记不应流于形式。
我们认为，在重新登记完成后，俄国侨民委员会将在民族反共报纸上公布名单，准确反映反共侨民的数量。
所有在委员会注册的侨民机构、社团和商业企业均应列入该名单。简言之——所有构成当地反共侨民活跃力量的组成部分。

Then everything will be clear and easy to understand.
There will be no misunderstandings, no confusion. Only then it

The following comments are made in reply to criticism which appeared in the local press concerning the Declaration made by local White Russian Emigrants' Organizations, a copy of which is attached.

The very large number of Russians who arrived in Shanghai during 1920-1922 left their country not because they were afraid of privations and persecutions, but because, being unable to continue their struggle against communism in Russia, they wanted to carry it on from the outside as political emigrants and they are still doing so. These Russians do not consider the term „Motherland“ as meaning merely territory, which is unstable and may even be entirely lost (as in the case of Serbia during the Great War), but as meaning primarily the people and their active and creative national spirit. They know that during the last 24 years the Russian Nation was kept in a state of abject slavery without precedent in the history of Humanity.

Russia has lost millions of her best sons in her struggle for the most elementary rights of men: the right to worship God, to express national convictions, to have a family, to possess personal property, etc...

It is impossible to imagine anything more terrible, immoral and devastating than Soviet Regime, supported by the most cruel reign of terror. The Soviets are not only enemies of the Russian People, they are a menace to all Nations and to the whole of mankind - their favourite methods being subversive activity, corruption, propaganda and sabotage.

Although the above facts, well known to everybody, are at present being ignored, hushed up and passed over in silence by many foreigners for political reasons, Russians who still love Country and have personally experienced the horrors of bolshevism cannot be expected to refrain from expressing their hope that Soviet Regime will be destroyed as early as possible. Should these expressions be considered now as lack of tact? Should the Russian Emigrants be prevented from refuting the allegations of Soviet Agents that all Russians have joined the Red camp?

Russian Emigrants regret that the interests of the Democratic States are now linked by circumstances to the fate of the hated anti-democratic Soviet Regime and that these interests now require the survival and victory of the Moscow Government, although the relations between the democracies and the Soviets were until so very recently quite different. The tone and comments of the democratic press are also quite different now from what they were after the signing of the German-Soviet non-aggression pact and during the Soviet-Finnish campaign. Mr. Churchill himself in his speeches and books has expressed on many occasions his definite condemnation of Bolchevism.

It would appear the Soviet Regime is at present serving the purpose of those who recently regarded the Soviets as enemies of mankind.

But can it be expected of Russian Emigrants that they suddenly repudiate their ideals and start hoping for the victory of Russia's oppressors, just because it happens to suit the purpose of others at present?

The Russian people have made great sacrifices and efforts during the war of 1914-1919 towards a common victory of the Allied Forces, but were betrayed by the newly established Soviet Regime at the conference of Brest Litovsk.

What are the slaves of the Soviets fighting for now under the flag of the 3rd International? For Russia and her interesests? for democratic principles? Is it not obvious that if the Germans had not attacked on June 22, the Soviet forces massed on the Western border would have eventually started their own invasion of Europe, not for democratic principles, but for the purpose of starting a communist conflagration in the whole of Europe, including, of course England who was always considered by the Soviets as the stronghold of World Capitalism.

Though it may be undesirable to many, Russian Emigrants still continue to consider Bolchevism as the creation of the Devil and the foe of cultural humanity, and under no conditions honest Russian Emigrants will ever support or recognize it. To try to persuade the White Emigrants of the contrary is absolutely useless.

Without seeking any personal benefit and remaining absolutely loyal to the local authorities, Russian Emigrants continue to hope for a speedy downfall of the Soviet Regime and the establishment of a National Government in Russia. What will take place after that cannot be now forseen and is known to God only, but they trust that the Russian People freed from Soviet oppression will be able to steer its own course and defend its National interests.

It is futile to teach patriotism to Russian Emigrants, the majority of them have proved their patriotism with their own blood during the Great and Civil Wars.

Unfortunately, a number of Emigrants have fallen prey to pseudo-patriotic propaganda of Soviet Agents and can no longer differentiate between the true interests of Russian and those of the 3rd Communist International.

Let God and the liberated Russian People be the sole judges in the above question:

以下评论是针对当地报刊就本地白俄侨民组织发表的声明（副本附后）所提出的批评而作出的回应。

1920-1922年间抵达上海的大量俄国人离开祖国，并非因为害怕匮乏和迫害，而是因为他们无法在俄国境内继续对抗共产主义，希望作为政治侨民从境外继续这一斗争，并且他们至今仍在这样做。这些俄国人并不认为“祖国”一词仅指领土，因为领土是不稳定的，甚至可能完全丧失（如大战期间的塞尔维亚），而是主要指人民及其活跃且富有创造力的民族精神。他们知道，在过去的24年里，俄罗斯民族处于人类历史上前所未有的卑贱奴役状态之中。

俄罗斯在争取最基本的人权——敬拜上帝的权利、表达民族信念的权利、拥有家庭的权利、拥有个人财产的权利等——的斗争中，失去了数百万最优秀的儿女……

难以想象有什么比由最残酷的恐怖统治支持的苏维埃政权更可怕、更不道德、更具破坏性了。苏维埃不仅是俄罗斯人民的敌人，也是所有国家和全人类的威胁——他们惯用的手段是颠覆活动、腐败、宣传和破坏。

尽管上述事实众所周知，但目前许多外国人出于政治原因对其视而不见、加以掩盖并保持沉默，但不能指望那些仍然热爱祖国并亲身经历过布尔什维克主义恐怖的俄国人克制自己，不表达希望苏维埃政权尽早灭亡的愿望。难道现在这些表达会被视为缺乏策略吗？难道应该阻止俄国侨民反驳苏维埃代理人关于所有俄国人都已加入红色阵营的指控吗？

俄国侨民感到遗憾的是，民主国家的利益目前因局势而与令人憎恨的反民主苏维埃政权的命运联系在一起，并且这些利益现在要求莫斯科政府的生存和胜利，尽管民主国家与苏维埃之间的关系直到不久前还截然不同。民主报刊的语气和评论也与德苏互不侵犯条约签署后及苏芬战役期间大不相同。丘吉尔先生本人在其演讲和著作中曾多次明确谴责布尔什维克主义。

看来，苏维埃政权目前正服务于那些最近还将苏维埃视为人类公敌的人的目的。

但是，难道能指望俄国侨民仅仅因为这暂时符合他人的目的，就突然背弃自己的理想，开始希望俄罗斯的压迫者取得胜利吗？

俄罗斯人民在1914-1919年的战争中为协约国的共同胜利做出了巨大的牺牲和努力，但在布列斯特-立托夫斯克会议上遭到了新建立的苏维埃政权的背叛。

如今，苏维埃的奴隶们在第三国际的旗帜下战斗是为了什么？是为了俄罗斯及其利益吗？是为了民主原则吗？显而易见，如果德国人没有在6月22日发动进攻，集结在西部边境的苏维埃军队最终会自行发起对欧洲的入侵，这不是为了民主原则，而是为了在整个欧洲（当然包括一直被苏维埃视为世界资本主义堡垒的英国）点燃共产主义战火。

尽管这可能令许多人感到不快，但俄国侨民仍继续将布尔什维克主义视为魔鬼的造物和文化人类的敌人，在任何情况下，诚实的俄国侨民都不会支持或承认它。试图说服白俄侨民相信相反的观点是绝对徒劳的。

俄国侨民不求任何个人利益，并始终保持对当地当局的绝对忠诚，他们继续希望苏维埃政权迅速垮台，并在俄罗斯建立民族政府。此后会发生什么，现在无法预见，只有上帝知道，但他们相信，从苏维埃压迫中解放出来的俄罗斯人民将能够把握自己的方向，捍卫其民族利益。

向俄国侨民灌输爱国主义是徒劳的，他们中的大多数人在大战和内战期间已用自己的鲜血证明了他们的爱国主义。

不幸的是，一部分侨民已成为苏维埃代理人伪爱国宣传的牺牲品，再也无法区分俄罗斯的真正利益与第三共产国际的利益。

让上帝和获得解放的俄罗斯人民成为上述问题的唯一裁判：

NOTICE.

In accordance with the wishes expressed by many mem-
bers of the Russian Emigrant Community regarding the creation
here of a special Anti-Communist Fund and welcoming this sug-
gestion, the Russian Emigrants Committee has the honour of giv-
ing hereby notice to all members of the Russian community that
a special fund to be known as the "Russian Anti-Communist
Fund" has been created at the Russian Emigrants Committee.

Persons wishing to contribute towards the Fund may
do so through the medium of the Russian Emigrants Committee
against proper receipts.

account, and a special committee consisting of representatives
of various public organizations of Russian emigrants in Shang-

No private persons and/or any separate organizations
have been authorized and will not be authorized in future by
the Russian Emigrants Committee to make collections towards
this fund.

Contributions towards the Fund may only be made at
the offices of the Committee, 118/1 Moulmein Road, during of-
fice hours.

N.A. IVANOFF,
Chairman of the Russian Emigrants
Committee.

August 23, 1941
Shanghai.

Days of the Soviet government have been count-
ed. The main forces of the Red Army have been smashed. All the
"defence lines" of the bolsheviks have been pierced. The mist
created by the lying Soviet propaganda is vanishing and the
red troops go over to the united fascist forces without fear.
The hatred of the oppressed masses towards Stalin is reaching
its summit being ready to break out in open and widespread re-
volts. English and American help to the bolsheviks is but ano-
ther fiction. The fat of Kiev, Moscow and Leningrad is haging
only by a thread. Following the fall of these towns a Russian
National Government will be proclaimed, and the bolsheviks
will be regarded as gangs of bandits to be liquidated by spe-
cial punishment detachments. The cadres of such RUSSIAN punish-
ment detachments have already been prepared in the majority of
cases.

However, it is not our intention to discuss this
subject to-day. To-day we are very much interested by the
watershed which is being created in the Russian community in
Shanghai - a line clearly separating that community into two
camps: the Judeo-communist camp, which defends the U.S.S.R.,
and the Russian nationalist camp, which looks forward to a de-
feat of the U.S.S.R. in the name of revival of National Russia.
The dividing line passes through all the classes of the com-
munity, through all emigrant organizations and thus facilitates
the work of purging the community, of sifting its co-
lourless mass through the sifter of national self-conscious-
ness. The sifting process is still in progress, but even now
the outlines of the two camps are already visible in the so-
called Russian emigrant community in Shanghai: the openly bol-
shevist, red, Judeo-communist camp, which is condemning itself
to death, and the white, Russian, national camp, which is openly
prepared for the work of building up of a New Russia, the
Fascist Russia.

We, Fascists, welcome the outcry which was
raised in the Russian community following the outbreak of the
present Soviet-German war. It facilitates our task of SELECTION
of the strongest and most reliable elements for the future
work for the common Russian cause.

We are very much interested in the carrying this
Selection of brave and honest Russian people from amidst the
whole Russian community in Shanghai. By doing so we at the
same time can get an idea of the strength of our enemies as
well. All these pro-bolshevist gentry, who are in the enticing
captivity of the Soviet, British and American intelligence ser-
vices and defend the Jews and communists, are simply asking to
be placed on the black board.

Our readers will understand without any further
explanations the significance of this work and its importance
for the future life of Russian emigrants, who have ceased to be
just a shapeless mass, but are sharply divided into two groups:
POLITICAL EMIGRANTS, i.e. open enemies of the Judeo-communist
U.S.S.R., and REFUGEES, i.e. people of a doubtful quality. In
short, Russian emigrants will have to pass through a purifying
fire before they can return to their homeland, for it is clear

苏维埃政府的日子已经屈指可数。红军的主力已被击溃。布尔什维克的所有“防线”均已被突破。由谎言般的苏维埃宣传所制造的迷雾正在消散，红色部队正毫无畏惧地倒向统一的法西斯力量。被压迫群众对斯大林的仇恨已达到顶峰，随时可能爆发为公开且广泛的起义。英美对布尔什维克的援助不过是另一种虚构。基辅、莫斯科和列宁格勒的命运仅系于一线。随着这些城市的陷落，将宣告成立一个俄罗斯民族政府，而布尔什维克将被视为匪帮，由特别惩罚分队予以肃清。此类俄罗斯惩罚分队的骨干在大多数情况下已准备就绪。

然而，我们今天无意讨论这一主题。今天我们非常关注的是上海俄语社区中正在形成的分水岭——一条将该社区清晰划分为两个阵营的界线：一个是捍卫苏联的犹太-共产主义阵营，另一个是以复兴民族俄罗斯为名、期待苏联战败的俄罗斯民族主义阵营。这条分界线贯穿社区的各个阶层，贯穿所有移民组织，从而有助于通过民族自我意识的筛子对社区进行清洗，筛选出其原本色彩模糊的群体。筛选过程仍在进行中，但即便现在，在上海所谓的俄罗斯移民社区中，两个阵营的轮廓已清晰可见：一个是公开布尔什维克化、红色的、犹太-共产主义的阵营，它正自取灭亡；另一个是白色的、俄罗斯的、民族的阵营，它正公开准备建设新俄罗斯、即法西斯俄罗斯的工作。

我们法西斯主义者欢迎在当前苏德战争爆发后俄罗斯社区中引发的强烈反响。这有助于我们完成挑选任务，为未来共同俄罗斯事业的工作选拔最坚强、最可靠的分子。

我们非常有兴趣从上海整个俄罗斯社区中进行这种勇敢诚实的俄罗斯人的甄选工作。通过这样做，我们也可以同时了解敌人的实力。所有这些亲布尔什维克的绅士们，正处于苏联、英国和美国情报机构诱人的掌控之中，并维护犹太人和共产主义者，他们简直是在要求被列入黑名单。

我们的读者无需进一步解释即可理解这项工作的意义及其对未来俄罗斯移民生活的重要性，这些移民不再只是一个无定形的群体，而是被鲜明地分为两类：政治移民，即犹太-共产主义苏联的公开敌人；以及难民，即品质可疑的人。简而言之，俄罗斯移民在返回祖国之前必须经过净化的烈火，因为显然

TO RUSSIAN EMIGRANT COMMUNITY IN SHANGHAI

Recognizing the protection and defence of national interests of the Russian community in Shanghai as the main object of its activities the Russian Emigrants Committee, having considered at its meeting of August 1, 1941 the situation created in the local community in connection with the present events in our motherland, unanimously decided to issue the following appeal to Russian emigrants in Shanghai:-

(1) Being resident in the territory of Great China and enjoying the hospitality of the local authorities, Russian emigrants should above all be absolutely loyal towards these authorities by carrying out all their regulations and instructions, as only by so doing they may enjoy all the rights and privileges granted to them by the authorities in question.

(2) Refraining from being in any way involved in any political activities of an international character, which are taking such a stormy turn in Shanghai at present, Russian emigrants should not for a moment forget that the main features determining their belonging to the Russian Emigrant community are: absolutely negative attitude towards the Soviet government, objection to any contact with persons professing communist tendencies and refusal to cooperate in any manner with all those who are employed by the Soviet government or are its agents and/or sympathisers, irrespective of whether they are Russians or foreigners.

(3) Emigrants should always bear in mind that their main enemy is the government which has for the past 24 years been keeping in a state of slavery the Great Russian People groaning under the communist yoke and has been persecuting them even for confessing the religion of their ancestors. 致上海俄罗斯移民社区

俄罗斯移民委员会认为保护和维护上海俄罗斯社区的民族利益是其活动的主要目标，该委员会在1941年8月1日的会议上审议了因我国当前事件而在当地社区造成的局势，一致决定向上海的俄罗斯移民发出以下呼吁：-

(1) 居住在大中华领土上并享受当地政府款待的俄罗斯移民，首先应对这些当局保持绝对忠诚，执行其所有规章和指令，因为只有这样才能享有有关当局授予他们的所有权利和特权。

(2) 俄罗斯移民应避免以任何方式卷入目前在上海如此激烈发展的任何具有国际性质的政治活动，并应时刻不忘，决定其属于俄罗斯移民社区的主要特征是：对苏维埃政府持完全否定的态度，反对与任何信奉共产主义倾向的人接触，并拒绝以任何方式与所有受雇于苏维埃政府或是其代理人和/或同情者的人合作，无论他们是俄罗斯人还是外国人。

(3) 移民应始终牢记，他们的主要敌人是那个在过去24年里使呻吟在共产主义枷锁下的伟大俄罗斯人民处于奴隶状态、甚至因他们信奉祖先的宗教而迫害他们的政府。对我们沙皇及其皇室家族的卑鄙暗杀，对我们东正教会许多高级神职人员的谋杀，以及

pages.en:
millions of our brethren as well as **〔此处转录不清〕** of truly Rus-
sian people who are still subjected to unheard of tortures in
the various concentration camps and prisons - such crimes com-
mitted by the hangmen of our Motherland will never be forgiven
and cannot be forgotten by any honest Russian patriot.

(4) Emigrants are now subjected to the effects of a
distinct propaganda on the part of some of the local foreign re-
sidents who by means of various pseudo-patriotic slogans endea-
vour to bring about a reconciliation of emigrants with the pre-
sent government of the U.S.S.R. As many emigrants are in a
state of economic dependency on the said foreigners such a pro-
paganda bears certain fruits, bringing confusion and discord in-
to our emigrant family. However, emigrants should firmly bear
in mind that activities of this nature are extremely harmful to
our national interests, as they delay the coming of the hour of
liberation of our native country from the communist yoke.

Emigrants should have only one reply to the propaganda
referred to above: as long as the struggle is being carried on
in the name of the U.S.S.R. and not in the name of Russia, as
long as it is carried on under the emblems unacceptable to Rus-
sians professing the Orthodox Faith, and not under the sign of
Holy Cross and our national banners -any assistance on the part
of emigrants will constitute a crime against the Holy Russia and
our Great People. Instead of benefiting our Motherland such
an assistance will only tighten the noose on her neck, for it
will help not Russia, but her hangmen.

(5) Without loosing for a moment their confidence in
in the coming Ressurrection of our Motherland, emigrants should
at present devote all their efforts to one aim only, namely 6
to facilitate by every means at their disposal the return, as
soon as possible, of Russia on her historic road and her re-
birth in her former greatness and glory.

N.A. IVANOFF
Chairman of the Russian Emigrants
Committee.
August 8, 1941,

(4) 移民目前正受到部分当地外籍居民特定宣传的影响，这些人通过各种伪爱国主义口号，试图促使移民与苏联现政府和解。由于许多移民在经济上依赖上述外国人，这种宣传产生了一定的效果，给我们的移民家庭带来了混乱和不和。然而，移民应 firmly 牢记，此类活动对我们的民族利益极为有害，因为它们推迟了我国从共产主义枷锁下获得解放的时刻到来。

对于上述宣传，移民只应有一种回答：只要斗争是以苏联的名义而不是以俄罗斯的名义进行的，只要斗争是在信奉东正教的俄罗斯人所不能接受的标志下进行的，而不是在圣十字架和我们民族旗帜的标志下进行的——移民的任何援助都构成对神圣俄罗斯和我们伟大人民的犯罪。这种援助不仅无益于祖国，反而只会收紧套在她脖子上的绞索，因为它帮助的不是俄罗斯，而是她的刽子手。

(5) 移民在对祖国即将到来的复活保持信心片刻不离的同时，目前应将所有精力集中于一个目标，即利用其掌握的一切手段，尽可能促进俄罗斯尽快回归其历史道路，并在其昔日的伟大和荣耀中获得重生。

N.A. 伊万诺夫
俄罗斯移民委员会主席

致上海俄罗斯移民社区

承认保护和维护上海俄罗斯社区的民族利益为其活动的主要任务，俄罗斯移民委员会在8月1日的理事会会议上，审议了因我国当前事件而在当地社区造成的局势，一致决定向上海俄罗斯移民发出以下呼吁：

1. 居住在大中华领土上并享受当地政府款待的俄罗斯移民，首先应对这些当局保持完全忠诚，执行其所有决议、规则和命令，因为只有遵守这些规定，他们才能享有上述当局授予他们的所有权利和特权。

2. 绝不介入目前在上海如此激烈发展的任何具有国际性质的政治活动，俄罗斯移民不应片刻忘记，属于俄罗斯移民社区成员的主要区别特征是：对苏维埃政权持完全否定态度，不接受与任何持有共产主义倾向的人有任何接触，并拒绝与所有作为苏维埃政府仆役、代理人或同情者的人进行任何工作或合作，无论这些人是俄罗斯人还是外国人。

3. 移民应始终牢记，其主要敌人是那个政府，它在近24年里使在共产主义政权枷锁下挣扎的伟大俄罗斯人民处于奴隶状态，甚至因他们信奉祖先的信仰而迫害他们。对我们沙皇及其皇室家族的卑鄙暗杀，众多东正教会高级神职人员的死亡，数百万同胞的遇难，以及无数至今仍在集中营和牢狱中遭受闻所未闻折磨的真正俄罗斯人——这些由我们祖国刽子手犯下的罪行，任何诚实的俄罗斯爱国者都永远不会宽恕，也不能忘记。

4. 移民目前正受到部分当地外籍居民的特定加工处理，这些人通过各种伪爱国主义口号，试图达成移民与苏联现政府的和解。由于许多移民在经济上依赖于上述外籍人士，此类活动取得了一定成果，给移民社区带来了困惑和分裂。但移民应 firmly 牢记，此类活动对我们的民族利益极为有害，因为它推迟了我们祖国从共产主义政权枷锁下获得解放的时刻。对于此类举动，移民只能有一个回答：只要斗争是以苏联的名义而不是以俄罗斯的名义进行的，只要斗争是在东正教俄罗斯移民所不能接受的标志下进行的，而不是在圣十字架和我们民族旗帜的标志下——直到那时，移民的任何援助都是对神圣俄罗斯和我们伟大人民的犯罪。这种援助不仅无益于祖国，反而只会更紧地收紧套在她脖子上的绞索，因为它是帮助俄罗斯的刽子手，而不是帮助俄罗斯。

5. 在对亲爱的祖国即将到来的复活保持信心片刻不离的同时，移民目前应将所有力量专门导向唯一的目标，即：利用其支配下的一切手段，促进俄罗斯尽快回归其历史道路，并在其昔日所有的伟大和荣耀中重生。

N. A. 伊万诺夫
上海俄罗斯移民委员会主席
上海市，
1941年8月8日。

Russians Here Incensed Over Anti-Soviet Declaration By 21 Emigre “Organizations”

Twenty-one “White” Russian “organizations,” the majority of them no more than a name and members as rare as the dodo, on Thursday published a “declaration” in the Shanghai Zaria. This declaration, denouncing Soviet Russia, and outspokenly pro-German, hailed the Russo-German conflict as a war of liberation from Bolshevism. It lamented the Soviet propaganda to which the Russian emigre youth here was being exposed, and was obviously conceived with a view to “guiding” Shanghai’s “White” Russians in their attitude toward the war.

The “declaration” unwittingly did more to fan the flames of patriotism among local Russian emigres than the Soviet propaganda it had so deliberately denounced, and reactions among the Russian colony were more violent than at any other time.

For example, Colonel N. Tornovsky, regimental commander in the Tsar’s Imperial Army, replying to the declaration yesterday in a letter to the Zaria, made known his intention to resign from the Union of Russian Army and Navy Men, one of the signatories. Another Tsarist officer, Captain of the Guards Bajenov, in no uncertain terms expressed his opposition to the text of the declaration.

Reflect General Attitude

Both letters were merely reflections of the indignation which the declaration had aroused among local Russians, both from Tsarist officers who had fought in the Great War and subsequently against the Bolshevik forces, subsequently withdrawing across the frontier to Manchuria.

No less significant, too, was the note inserted by the editor of the Shanghai Zaria into the correspondence columns, announcing that correspondence on “this subject” is considered closed.

The declaration itself was, perhaps, tactless in that its flagrant support of the German cause was an insult to Russian patriotism, party differences being here of no account whatever.

Orthodox Church and the murder of the Russian Tsar and his family, likewise we cannot forgive the detention and murder of millions of Russians in concentration camps and cellars of the G.P.U. . . .”

“We consider the present German-Soviet war as a way and means of freeing our country from communist oppression . . . Although we are deprived of present circumstances of the possibility of actively participating in the armed struggle taking place on the fields of our country . . . we still must apply our efforts to the downfall of the Soviet regime in Russia. . . .”

Commenting on the Reuters cable in which it was stated that the ex-Tsarist diplomat, Mr. Sablin, considered the leader of Russian emigrants in Britain, appealed to all emigres to support Soviet Russia, the declaration stated: “If the Reuters dispatch regarding the appeal of the ex-Tsarist diplomat, Mr. Sablin, to support the Soviets is true, Mr. Sablin’s statement must have been made under considerable pressure by powers hostile to us. . . .”

Hits “Back-Stabbers”

Colonel Tornovsky, in resigning from the Union of Russian Army and Navy Men, wrote that he did so because the declaration intimated that its signatories represented the views of all its members.

“Stalin’s regime to you is unacceptable,” he wrote, “but we consider this an internal, Russian issue, and in an hour fraught with danger for the entire Russian people (including emigrants), it is criminal to stab our motherland in the back.

“If we are unable to actively help our motherland, since the Stalin government will neither trust nor call us, then there remains for us no alternative but to adopt a sympathetic neutrality toward the Russian people and its army.

“We cannot rejoice over the death of millions of wonderful, sacrificed young men who with their blood defended Russian soil. Under their Red Army tunics beats a heart no less Russian than ours. We send the defenders of our motherland our sincere wishes for complete victory on the fields of battle, and pray the Lord our God to help them defend our land from the proven enemies of all Russians and Slavs—the Ger-

“Uncompromising”

“We remain, as we have been for over 20 years, uncompromising enemies of communism. We never trusted and we do not believe now in the evolution of the Soviet regime . . .” states the declaration.

“. . . We, Russian emigrants of Shanghai, will never forget nor forgive the Soviet regime the desecration and persecution of the mans.

Service 40 Years

“These are my views, which seem in discord with the majority of the Union’s members, and thus to my profound regret I must tender my resignation from this organization, of which I have been a member since 1923. Thirty-seven years have I served in officers’ ranks, and have devoted faithfully and loyally 40 years in service to my motherland. I thought I was tied with unbreakable bonds to other members of the Union, having defended our motherland in the Russo-Japanese War, the Great War, and the war against the Bolsheviks, and believe me that it is with the greatest of sorrow that I sever these ties, but I can at present see no other course of action.

“To convince me, and especially for me to convince you in views we regard as wrong, is unnecessary—we are grey with years and worldly experience, and know what we do. Only history will show which of us were right.”

在沪俄国人因21个流亡“组织”发表反苏宣言而愤慨

二十一个“白”俄“组织”（其中大多数徒有虚名，成员稀少得如同渡渡鸟）于周四在《上海柴拉报》（Shanghai Zaria）上发表了一份“宣言”。该宣言谴责苏维埃俄国，公然亲德，将俄德冲突欢呼为从布尔什维克主义中解放出来的战争。它 lamented（哀叹）在此地的俄国流亡青年正遭受苏维埃宣传的影响，其构思显然是为了“引导”上海的“白”俄人在战争问题上的态度。

这份“宣言”无意中比它所刻意谴责的苏维埃宣传更大地煽动了本地俄国流亡者中的爱国热情，俄国侨民界的反应比以往任何时候都更为激烈。

例如，沙皇帝国军队的团级指挥官N.托尔诺夫斯基（N. Tornovsky）上校昨日在致《柴拉报》的信中回应了该宣言，表示打算退出“俄国陆海军人员联盟”（Union of Russian Army and Navy Men），该联盟是宣言签署方之一。另一位沙皇军官、近卫军巴热诺夫（Bajenov）上尉也毫不含糊地表达了对宣言文本的反对。

反映普遍态度

这两封信仅仅反映了该宣言在本地俄国人中激起的愤慨，这些俄国人包括曾在第一次世界大战中作战、随后又对抗布尔什维克部队、最后撤过边境进入满洲的沙皇军官。

同样具有重要意义的是，《上海柴拉报》编辑在来信栏目中插入的一则启事，宣布关于“此主题”的通信已告结束。

这份宣言本身或许有些失策，因为它对德国事业的公然支持是对俄国爱国主义的侮辱，而在此时，党派分歧已完全无关紧要。

东正教会以及谋杀俄国沙皇及其家人的行为，同样，我们也无法原谅在集中营和格别乌（G.P.U）的地窖中对数百万俄国人的拘留和谋杀____”

“我们将当前的德苏战争视为将我国从共产主义压迫下解放出来的一种方式和手段……尽管在目前的情况下，我们被剥夺了积极参与在我国战场上进行的武装斗争的可能性……但我们仍必须致力于推翻俄国的苏维埃政权____”

针对路透社电文中称前沙皇外交官、被视为英国俄国流亡者领袖的萨布林（Sablin）先生呼吁所有流亡者支持苏维埃俄国一事，该宣言评论道：“如果关于前沙皇外交官萨布林先生呼吁支持苏维埃政权的路透社消息属实，那么萨布林先生的声明一定是在敌对势力的巨大压力下做出的____”

抨击“背后捅刀者”

托尔诺夫斯基上校在辞去“俄国陆海军人员联盟”职务时写道，他这样做是因为该宣言暗示其签署人代表了该联盟所有成员的观点。

“斯大林的政权对你们来说是不可接受的，”他写道，“但我们认为这是一个内部的俄国问题，而在整个俄国人民（包括流亡者）面临危险的时刻，背后捅自己祖国一刀是犯罪性的。

“如果我们无法积极帮助我们的祖国，因为斯大林政府既不信任我们，也不会征召我们，那么我们别无选择，只能对俄国人民及其军队采取同情的中立态度。

“我们不能为成千上万优秀的、牺牲的年轻男子的死亡而高兴，他们用鲜血保卫了俄国的土地。在他们红军制服下跳动的心，与我们的一样具有俄国性。我们向祖国的保卫者们致以在战场上取得完全胜利的真诚祝愿，并祈祷上帝帮助他们从所有俄国人和斯拉夫人的确凿敌人——德

“不妥协”

“正如过去二十多年一样，我们仍然是共产主义的不妥协敌人。我们从未信任过，现在也不相信苏维埃政权的演变……”宣言 stated（陈述）。

“……我们，上海的俄国流亡者，永远不会忘记，也永远不会原谅苏维埃政权对 mans（原文不清，疑为men，即人/男子）的亵渎和迫害。

服务四十年

“这些是我的观点，似乎与联盟大多数成员的意见相左，因此我深感遗憾，必须辞去该组织的职务，我自1923年起便是其成员。我在军官阶层服役了三十七年，忠实地为祖国服务了四十年。我以为我与联盟的其他成员有着不可打破的纽带，因为我们曾在日俄战争、第一次世界大战以及对抗布尔什维克的战争中保卫过我们的祖国，请相信，我怀着极大的悲痛切断这些联系，但我目前看不到其他行动方针。

“说服我，尤其是让我去说服你们接受我们认为错误的观点，是没有必要的——我们已是满头白发，拥有丰富的世事经验，知道自己在做什么。只有历史才能证明我们谁是对的。”

敦促日本民众防范间谍活动
（路透社）

东京，7月30日电。——今日被任命为检事总长的松阪弘正（Hiromasa Matsusaka）先生告诉日本新闻界，目前对日本司法当局而言，“思想控制和反间谍”最为重要。他接替了上周五被任命为司法部大臣的岩村通世（Michiyo Iwamura）先生。

松阪先生强调要保护国家机密，并镇压无论多么轻微的“反军事谣言、言论和行动”，

Local Russian
Announcer Said
Banned by Police

Mr. V. V. Drozdoff, assistant editor
of the "Russian Daily News" who is
well known to Russian radio listen-
ers here as a broadcaster of Russian
war news, especially new items re-
leased by the Tass Agency, yester-
day informed the "North China
Daily News" that he will no longer
go on the air over radio station
XMHC as he has been informed that
his broadcast has been banned by
the French Police. The station,
which is operated by the "Evening
Post and Mercury" at 19 Avenue
Edward VII, Mr. Drozdoff stated, had
notified him that under the circum-
stances, his contract with them would
have to be cancelled.

Mr. Drozdoff did not go on the
air yesterday with his usual Russian
news at 7 p.m. He declared that he
was completely taken by surprise at
the action of the French Police as
the news he had announced daily
was entirely devoid of propaganda.
He emphasized that he had merely
transmitted news, principally from
Moscow, as he had obtained it.

Other Offers Received

It is believed that he has received
numerous letters from radio stations
in the Settlement asking him to con-
tinue his broadcasts to the Russian
community here over their stations.
Russian circles here yesterday de-
clared that the new broadcast by
Mr. Drozdoff had been welcomed by
local Russian radio listeners as it
counteracted news in Russian, inter-
spersed with Nazi propaganda, broad-
cast by a German radio station here.
Mr. Drozdoff admitted that he had
received more than 200 telephone
calls from sympathizers here who
hoped that he would not desist from
continuing his broadcasts of news re-
garding the war in Soviet Russia.

本地俄国
播音员称
被警方禁止

《俄国日报》（Russian Daily News）副主编V. V.德罗兹多夫（V. V. Drozdoff）先生，作为在此地俄国无线电听众中广为人知的俄国战况新闻播音员，特别是播报塔斯社发布的最新消息，昨日告知《字林西报》（North China Daily News），他将不再通过XMHC广播电台进行广播，因为他已获悉其广播已被法国警察禁止。德罗兹多夫先生称，该电台由位于爱多亚路（Avenue Edward VII）19号的《晚报与水星报》（Evening Post and Mercury）运营，已通知他在这种情况下，他与电台的合同必须取消。

德罗兹多夫先生昨日未在晚上7点播出他惯常的俄国新闻。他表示，他对法国警察的行动感到完全意外，因为他每日播报的新闻完全不包含宣传内容。他强调，他只是如实转播新闻，主要来自莫斯科。

收到其他邀请

据信，他已收到租界内多家广播电台的许多来信，邀请他继续通过他们的电台向在沪俄国社区进行广播。在沪俄国界人士昨日表示，德罗兹多夫先生的新广播受到本地俄国无线电听众的欢迎，因为它抵消了此地一家德国广播电台播出的夹杂纳粹宣传的俄语新闻。德罗兹多夫先生承认，他已收到本地同情者打来的200多个电话，希望他不要停止继续播报有关苏维埃俄国战争的 news（新闻）。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

REPORT
9411/9
/ 8 / 141

Special Branch Station File No. Date August 1, 1941.

SUBJECT: Declaration of a group of Russian emigrant organizations in Shanghai defining their attitude towards the present Soviet-German war.

Forwarded herewith is a translation of a declaration of a group of local Russian emigrant organizations which was published in all Russian emigrant newspapers in Shanghai on July 31, 1941.

It is reported that on 23-7-41 a conference attended by some 60 persons representing various circles of the Russian emigrant community was held in a private residence in the French Concession. After an exchange of opinions as to whether or not the local Russian community should express openly its attitude towards the present Soviet-German war, the suggestion of an anonymous initiative group was approved that a declaration to that effect should be published without delay. During the course of the following several days the text of the attached declaration was worked out and signed by representatives of 21 organizations and/or groups.

According to information to hand, there are groups and organizations amongst the Russian emigrant community who, for various reasons, do not approve this declaration as a whole.

Further report on this matter will be submitted as soon as more definite information is available.

A. Prokopiev
D. I.

A. C. ( Special Branch ).

DECLARATION
of the Russian emigrant community in
Shanghai

We, Russian emigrants in Shanghai, deem it necessary to
make the following declaration through representatives of the
undermentioned Russian national, military and public organiza-
tions:

We still are, as we were 20 years ago, irreconcilable
enemies of communism which established itself in Russia. We
never believed and still do not believe in the evolution of
the Soviet government. The events of the last two years - oc-
cupation of Poland, Estonia, Lithuania, Latvia and Bukovina - have
clearly proved that the principles and methods of the Soviet
regime, applied in the occupied areas, remain the same as they
were before.

On the other hand the attitude of the bulk of the popula-
tion of Russia towards their oppressors remains as hostile as
it was during the past 20 years. The restoration of the insti-
tute of political commissars in the Red Army is a vivid proof
of this fact.

We, Russian emigrants, will never forget and forgive the
Soviet government the disgracing and persecution of the Rus-
sian Orthodox Church and the assassination of Russian Tsar and
His Family. We also cannot forgive the present murders of mil-
lions of Russians in the various concentration camps, Cheka dun-
geons and in the army where soldiers are driven to battles by
armed commissars.

We regard the present Soviet-German war as a means of li-
beration of our Motherland from the communist yoke. We firmly
believe that this war will release active national elements of
the Russian people and will result in the formation of a Natio-
nal Government and revival of Great Russia.

At the same time we brand the treacherous activities di-
rected towards moral disintegration of Russian emigrants, espe-
cially the younger generation who know neither the old nor
Soviet Russia and therefore easily fall under the influence of
the pseudo-patriotic bolshevik propaganda assisted by pro-
communist elements and corrupt press, subsidized by the Soviets
and their allies and fraudulently misrepresenting the true
sentiments of Russian emigrants.

If there is any truth in Reuter's report regarding the
appeal of Sablin -ex-Tsarist diplomatic official - to defend
the U.S.S.R., this step must have been taken by Sablin under
pressure on the part of the forces hostile to us. We are con-
fident that his appeal does not in any way express the senti-
ments of Russian emigrants living in England. Of course, they
think and feel as we do.

Being at present deprived of the possibility of an active
participation in the armed struggle against the communist rule
on the fields of our native country we, nevertheless, should make
every effort in order to assist in the overthrow of the Soviet

声明
上海俄国侨民社区

我们，在上海的俄国侨民，认为有必要通过下述俄国民族、军事和公共组织的代表发表以下声明：

正如二十年前一样，我们仍然是已在俄罗斯确立的共产主义的不可调和的敌人。我们过去不相信，现在也不相信苏联政府的演变。过去两年的事件——占领波兰、爱沙尼亚、立陶宛、拉脱维亚和布科维纳——清楚地证明，苏联政权在占领区适用的原则和方法与以前完全相同。

另一方面，俄罗斯广大民众对其压迫者的态度仍然像过去二十年那样充满敌意。红军中恢复政治委员制度就是这一事实的有力证明。

我们俄国侨民永远不会忘记也不会原谅苏联政府对俄罗斯东正教的侮辱和迫害，以及对俄国沙皇及其家人的暗杀。我们也无法原谅目前在各种集中营、契卡地牢以及军队中对数百万俄国人的谋杀，在那里士兵们是在武装委员的驱赶下投入战斗的。

我们将目前的苏德战争视为将我们的祖国从共产主义枷锁中解放出来的一种手段。我们坚信，这场战争将释放俄罗斯人民的积极民族力量，并将导致民族政府的成立和大俄罗斯的复兴。

同时，我们谴责旨在瓦解俄国侨民道德的那些背叛活动，特别是针对年轻一代的活动，他们既不了解旧俄罗斯，也不了解苏维埃俄罗斯，因此很容易受到伪爱国主义布尔什维克宣传的影响，这种宣传得到了亲共分子和腐败媒体的协助，这些媒体由苏联人及其盟友资助，并欺诈性地歪曲了俄国侨民的真实情感。

如果路透社关于前沙皇外交官员萨布林（Sablin）呼吁保卫苏联的报道有任何真实性，那么萨布林的这一步骤一定是在敌对势力的压力下采取的。我们确信，他的呼吁绝不代表居住在英国的俄国侨民的情感。当然，他们的想法和感受与我们一样。

虽然目前我们无法在祖国的战场上积极参与反对共产主义统治的武装斗争，但我们仍应尽一切努力协助推翻俄罗斯的苏联政权。

我们坚信，敌人的卑鄙活动

ОБРАЩЕНІЕ ЭМИГРАНТСКИХ ОРГАНИЗАЦІЙ
К РУССКИМ ЛЮДЯМ.

Мы, русскіе эмигранты города Шанхая, въ лицѣ представителей нижепоименованныхъ русскихъ національныхъ военныхъ и общественныхъ организацій сочли необходимымъ выступить съ нижеслѣдующей деклараціей:
Мы попрежнему, какъ и двадцать съ лишнимъ лѣтъ тому назадъ, остаемся непримиримыми врагами коммунизма, утвердившагося въ Россіи. Мы никогда не вѣрили и не вѣримъ въ эволюцію совѣтской власти. Событія послѣднихъ двухъ лѣтъ — занятіе Польши, Эстоніи, Литвы, Латвіи, Бессарабіи и Буковины — съ полной неопровержимостью показали, что принципы и методы совѣтскаго режима, примѣненные въ этихъ оккупированныхъ областяхъ, остались тѣ же, что и были.
С другой стороны, отношеніе коренного россійскаго населенія къ своимъ угнетателямъ осталось такимъ же враждебнымъ, какимъ оно было на протяженіи почти четверти вѣка, чему яркимъ доказательствомъ является возстановленіе въ красной арміи института политическихъ комиссаровъ.
Мы, русскіе эмигранты, никогда не забудемъ и не простимъ совѣтской власти поруганія и преслдованія Православной Церкви и убійства русскаго Царя и Его семьи, какъ не можемъ простить продолжающагося убійства милліоновъ русскихъ людей въ концентраціонныхъ лагеряхъ и подвалахъ чеки и насилія надъ солдатами, гонимыми въ бой подъ наганами комиссаровъ.
Настоящую германо-совѣтскую войну мы разсматриваемъ какъ путь къ освобожденію нашей Родины отъ ига коммунистовъ. Мы твердо вѣримъ, что эта война развяжетъ активныя національныя силы россійскаго народа и приведетъ къ созданію національнаго правительства и возрожденію Великой Россіи.
Одновременно мы клеймимъ предательскую работу по разложенію русской эмиграціи и особенно русской молодежи, не знающей ни старой ни совѣтской Россіи, а потому легко поддающейся лже-патріотической пропаганд со стороны большевиковъ, большевитствующихъ продажной и прессы, субсидируемой Совѣтами и ихъ союзниками, искажающей шулерской подтасовкой фактовъ подлинныя эмигрантскія настроенія.
Если телеграфное сообщеніе агентства Рейтер о выступленіи бывшаго царскаго дипломата Саблина съ призывомъ къ защитѣ Совтовъ является правдой, то это объясняется вынужденнымъ шагомъ Саблина подъ давленіемъ враждебныхъ намъ силъ. Мы увѣрены, что это его выступленіе отнюдь не является выраженіемъ истиннаго настроенія русскихъ людей, волею судебъ заброшенныхъ въ Англію. Они конечно, и думаютъ и чувствуютъ такъ же, какъ и мы.
Лишенные возможности въ настоящій моментъ при данной обстановкѣ съ оружіемъ въ рукахъ активно участвовать въ борьбѣ противъ совѣтской власти на поляхъ родной страны, мы все же должны приложить всѣ усилія содѣйствовать сверженію совѣтскаго режима въ Россіи.
Мы твердо убѣждены, что грязная работа враговъ національной Россіи не остановитъ неизбѣжнаго крушенія совѣтской власти, и что грядущая Великая Россія, какъ РАВНОПРАВНЫЙ ЧЛЕНЪ, войдетъ въ большую семью народовъ Европы и Азіи, строящихъ новый порядокъ на основахъ соціальной справедливости и національнаго самосознанія.

侨民组织致俄罗斯人民的呼吁书。

我们，上海城的俄国侨民，谨以下述俄国民族、军事和公共组织代表的名义，认为有必要发表如下声明：
我们一如既往，如同二十多年前一样，仍然是已在俄罗斯确立的共产主义的不可调和的敌人。我们过去不相信，现在也不相信苏维埃政权的演变。过去两年的事件——占领波兰、爱沙尼亚、立陶宛、拉脱维亚、比萨拉比亚和布科维纳——以无可辩驳的事实表明，苏维埃政权在这些占领区适用的原则和方法与以往完全相同。
另一方面，俄罗斯本土居民对其压迫者的态度仍然像近四分之一世纪以来那样充满敌意，红军中恢复政治委员制度就是这一点的有力证明。
我们，俄国侨民，永远不会忘记也不会原谅苏维埃政权对东正教的亵渎和迫害，以及对俄国沙皇及其家人的杀害；正如我们不能原谅在集中营和契卡地牢中持续杀害数百万俄国人，以及委员们在纳甘左轮手枪逼迫下驱使士兵投入战斗的暴行。
我们将当前的德苏战争视为将我们的祖国从共产主义枷锁中解放出来的途径。我们坚信，这场战争将释放俄罗斯人民的积极民族力量，并将导致民族政府的建立和大俄罗斯的复兴。
同时，我们谴责旨在瓦解俄国侨民，特别是俄国青年的背叛行为，这些青年既不了解旧俄罗斯，也不了解苏维埃俄罗斯，因此容易受到布尔什维克方面的伪爱国主义宣传的影响，这种宣传得到了受苏联及其盟友资助的腐败媒体的支持，并通过欺诈性的事实篡改歪曲了侨民的真实情绪。
如果路透社关于前沙皇外交官萨布林呼吁保卫苏维埃的电讯报道属实，那么这是萨布林在敌对势力压力下被迫采取的步骤。我们确信，他的这一举动绝非表达那些因命运安排而流落英国的俄国人的真实情绪。当然，他们的想法和感受与我们一样。
鉴于目前的局势，我们失去了手持武器在祖国土地上积极参与反对苏维埃政权斗争的可能性，但我们仍应尽一切努力协助推翻俄罗斯的苏维埃政权。
我们坚信，民族俄罗斯的敌人的肮脏工作不会阻止苏维埃政权的必然崩溃，未来的大俄罗斯将作为“平等成员”，加入欧洲和亚洲各民族的大家庭，这些民族正在基于社会正义和民族自觉的基础上建设新秩序。

Translation of an extract from an article which appeared in
Russian newspaper "Russian Times" of 30-7-41. Published by
the Russian Times Publishing Company, 409 East Ward Road.
Editor - Mr. C. V. Popoff.

THOUGHTS ABOUT SOVIET YOUTH, THE FUTURE
LEADER, EMIGRANT FIGURES AND STRUGGLE
FOR CHILDREN'S SOULS.

Pointing out the harmful influence of the communist
regime in the U.S.S.R. on the moral and character of the
younger generation the newspaper nevertheless believes that
there are excellent national-patriotic elements amongst the
youth of that country, which are now hiding themselves. On
these elements rests the hope for the national revival of Rus-
sia. Somewhere in that country will appear the Leader, who is
not know so far and for whom Russia has been waiting during
the past many years. The future Leader must be a second Peter
the Great in order to be able to carry out his task.

"It is an insult to the Great National State of Rus-
sia that a Shanghai bodyguard named Konstantin Stekloff, an
illiterate man, a mental pygmy has offered himself as a lea-
der of the Russian people and expressed his wish to put him-
self on the summit of glory without any struggle, without even
elementary political training and to be a Leader of the country
comprising one sixth part of the world's territory.

It is not difficult to recall what the road to lea-
dership was that was passed by all those whom God wished to
be leaders of peoples. Even Lenin, Trotsky and Stalin, who
were not chosen by God to be leaders of the Russian people,
even they were protected by the Satan himself.

Konstantin Stekloff wished all of a sudden to become
equal to Hitler or Mussolini and thus to secure a place in Rus-
sia's brilliant history. Is not it a shame, is not it a sign
of an utter lack of thought amongst Russian emigres!

God save us from such leaders suffering from megalo-
mania and giving a bad example to the emigrant youth..."

31-7-41.

译自1941年7月30日俄国报纸《俄罗斯时报》上发表的一篇文章摘录。由位于华德路409号的俄罗斯时报出版公司出版。编辑 - C. V. Popoff 先生。

关于苏联青年、未来领袖、侨民人物及争夺儿童灵魂的思考。

该报指出共产主义政权在苏联对年轻一代的道德和性格产生的有害影响，但仍相信该国青年中存在优秀的民族爱国元素，目前这些元素正处于隐藏状态。俄罗斯的民族复兴希望寄托在这些元素身上。在该国的某个地方，将出现一位迄今为止尚不为人知、俄罗斯已等待多年的领袖。未来的领袖必须是第二个彼得大帝，才能完成其任务。

“对于一个伟大的民族国家俄罗斯来说，这是一种侮辱：一个名叫康斯坦丁·斯捷克洛夫（Konstantin Stekloff）的上海保镖，一个文盲，一个智力侏儒，竟自荐为俄罗斯人民的领袖，并表示希望不经任何斗争，甚至没有基本的政治训练，就登上荣耀的顶峰，成为这个占据世界六分之一领土的国家的领袖。

不难回想，所有被上帝选为人民领袖的人所走过的领导之路是怎样的。即使是列宁、托洛茨基和斯大林，他们并非被上帝选为俄罗斯人民的领袖，甚至连他们都受到撒旦本人的庇护。

康斯坦丁·斯捷克洛夫突然希望与希特勒或墨索里尼平起平坐，从而在俄罗斯辉煌的历史中占据一席之地。这难道不是耻辱吗？这难道不是俄国侨民中极度缺乏思考的标志吗！

愿上帝保佑我们免受这类患有夸大狂、给侨民青年树立坏榜样的领袖之害……”

1941年7月31日。

cal situation in the U.S.A. where the activities of the
party are regarded with suspicion. Stekloff's declaration
also appears in the same issue and is also very lengthy
He announces that he has assumed the leadership of the
party and promises to carry on his service to the cause
of Russian National Revolution.

The "Russian Times" of 28-7-41 reprinted Stek-
loff's. telegram to the Soviet Government under the head-
ing : "WHAT IS IT - LACK OF COMMON SENSE OR DELIBERATE
PROVOCATION ?! Russian anti-communists,read the tele-
gram sent by Shanghai emigrant Stekloff to Stalin,hangman
of Russia, think it over and decide for yourselves."

全俄罗斯民族革命法西斯党 - 致苏联政府的电报。

继1941年7月24日的报告之后，我必须指出，根据1941年7月27日的《俄罗斯先锋报》， “全俄罗斯民族革命法西斯党”于1941年7月22日向苏联政府发送了上述电报。

在同一期《俄罗斯先锋报》上，刊登了 A.A. VONSIATSKY 的一份长篇声明，鉴于美国目前的政治局势，该党在美国的活动受到怀疑，他将党的领导权移交给其当地代表 K.A. STEKLOFF。斯捷克洛夫的声明也刊登在同一期上，篇幅也很长。他宣布已接管党的领导权，并承诺将继续为俄罗斯民族革命事业服务。

1941年7月28日的《俄罗斯时报》转载了斯捷克洛夫致苏联政府的电报，标题为：“这是什么——缺乏常识还是蓄意挑衅？！俄罗斯反共主义者，请阅读上海侨民斯捷克洛夫发给俄罗斯刽子手斯大林的电报，深思熟虑并自行判断。”

Translation from the "NOVOSTI DNIA" of 21-7-41.

"WE GIVE UP OUR OPPOSITION TO SOVIET GOVERNMENT". A letter to the
Editor from the Far Eastern Branch of the Mladorossy Party.

Sir,
Will you be good enough to publish the attached declara-
tion in your esteemed newspaper.

A. Pooliaevsky,
Chancellor of the Far Eastern Branch
of the Mladorossy Party.

Stepping forward once more with a clear statement of our
"credo" to-day when the destiny of our Motherland is being de-
cided, members of the Far Eastern Branch of the Mladorossy Party
wish in the first place to point out that the delay in publish-
ing this declaration was not caused by waiting for an opportune
moment. The more serious and dangerous the present situation is,
the more force and clearness it acquires in the Russian concep-
tion of the Mladorossy Party. The delay was caused by circumstan-
ces of emigrant life which in the majority of cases cannot be
overcome. Published to-day this statement only confirms once
more the principles which have remained unchanged for the past
fifteen years.

From the very beginning of its existence the Mladorossy
Party ( formerly known as the Union of Mladorossy ) has in all
its activities been directed solely by the interests of Russia
and Russian nation, i.e. the family of peoples grown and educated
by one and the same culture. Based on this principle the party
in its foreign policy was never hostile to any other state as
such, but defined its attitude towards a given state in accord-
ance with the attitude of that state towards the interests of
our Motherland.

In this sense the clearly hostile attitude of Germany
towards Russia, which has been emphasized since the beginning of
the 20-th century, led to the war of 1914 -1918 and later was
pages.zh:
译自1941年7月21日的《今日新闻》（NOVOSTI DNIA）。

“我们放弃对苏联政府的反对”。来自青年俄罗斯党（Mladorossy Party）远东支部致编辑的一封信。

先生：
恳请贵报刊登所附声明。

A. 普利亚耶夫斯基（A. Pooliaevsky），
青年俄罗斯党远东支部
秘书长

在当今祖国命运攸关之际，我们再次清晰地陈述我们的“信条”，青年俄罗斯党远东支部成员首先希望指出，推迟发表此声明并非因为等待时机。目前的局势越严重、越危险，它在青年俄罗斯党的俄罗斯观念中就越显得有力和清晰。推迟是由于流亡生活的情况所致，这在大多数情况下是无法克服的。今日发表的这份声明，只是再次确认了过去十五年来一直保持不变的原则。

青年俄罗斯党（前身为青年俄罗斯联盟）自成立之初，其所有活动就 solely 以俄罗斯及俄罗斯民族的利益为导向，即由同一文化孕育和教养的民族大家庭。基于这一原则，该党在外交政策上从未对任何特定国家本身怀有敌意，而是根据该国对我们祖国利益的态度来确定对其立场。

从这个意义上说，德国自20世纪初以来一直强调的对俄罗斯的明显敌对态度，导致了1914-1918年的战争，后来这种态度

pages.en:
- 2 -

expressed in the well known book "Mein Kampf" was apparent
to the Mladorossy Party. Even the short lived pact between
Germany and the U.S.S.R. could not change our opinion that
Germany is hostile to Russia and that this hostility is ex-
plained not only by motives of a transitory and ideologic
nature.

Precisely because of this certainty as to the attitude
of Germany the Mladorossy Party during the many years prior
to the war, as well as after its outbreak and after the pact
between Germany and the U.S.S.R. never ceased to advocate a
rapprochement with our natural allies - France and Great Bri-
tain, who would occupy the positions in the rear of Hitler's
inevitable and main push towards the East.

It is not Russia's fault that this rapprochement failed
to materialize and now is not the proper time to fix the res-
ponsibility for this failure.

But in the above sense, members of the Mladorossy Party
and other Russians who gave their lives on the battle-fields
of France two years ago, fell for their Motherland in the same
manner as Russian warriors who fall in defending their native
land.

To-day the inevitable that no pacts could prevent has
happened. Torrents of Russian blood are being shed along the
enormous front stretching from the Arctic Region to the Black
sea. The Russian people defends every inch of its territory
with super-human stubbornness.

At this hard time, the Far Eastern Branch of the Mlado-
rossy Party, being a part of the Russian people and fully rea-
lizing its duty towards Motherland, once more declares the
principles for which the Party has been standing:-

- At the time of terrible danger threatening our Mo-
therland, defence and not politics is the main thing.

- The place of all Russians is on the side of their
nation.
pages.zh:
- 2 -

在著名的《我的奋斗》一书中得到了体现，这对青年俄罗斯党来说是显而易见的。即使是德苏之间短暂的协定，也未能改变我们的观点，即德国对俄罗斯怀有敌意，且这种敌意不仅仅出于暂时性和意识形态方面的动机。

正是基于对德国态度的这种确定性，青年俄罗斯党在战前多年，以及在战争爆发后和德苏协定签订后，从未停止倡导与我们自然的盟友——法国和英国——修好，它们将在希特勒不可避免且主要的向东推进的后方占据阵地。

这种修好未能实现并非俄罗斯的过错，现在也不是追究此次失败责任的时候。

但在上述意义上，青年俄罗斯党成员以及其他两年前在法国战场上献出生命的俄罗斯人，就像保卫本土而牺牲的俄罗斯战士一样，为他们的祖国而死。

今天，任何协定都无法阻止的不可避免之事已经发生。从北极地区延伸到黑海的巨大战线上，俄罗斯人的鲜血正在流淌。俄罗斯人民以超人的顽强意志保卫着每一寸领土。

在这艰难时刻，作为俄罗斯人民一部分并充分认识到对祖国义务的青年俄罗斯党远东支部，再次重申该党一贯坚持的原则：

- 在祖国面临可怕危险的时刻，防御而非政治才是首要任务。

- 所有俄罗斯人的位置都在其民族的一边。

pages.en:
-3-

- Only to their native land can they give their blood.
and their strength.

- At the time when Motherland is fighting for her ex-
istence the Far Eastern Branch of the Mladprossy Par-
ty give up their opposition to the existing Government
in Russia, in so far as that Government defends Russia's
frontiers.

- Being deprived of the joy and possibility of defending
their native land they devote their words, deeds and
thoughts solely to their Motherland.

U. STEPANOFF,
Representative of the Mladorossy
Party in the Far East

July ,1941

- 由于被剥夺了保卫故土的喜悦和可能性，他们将言语、行动和思想完全奉献给祖国。

Edited and published by Mr. N.I.KORGANOFF,409 East Seward

RUSSIAN NATIONAL REVOLUTION IS IN
PROGRESS

We must participate in it

ALL-RUSSIA FASCIST UNION

Order No.13

(1) All nations in Europe are rising for the struggle against
the Jewish Comintern. This war is in the first place our
Russian war,and destruction of the Comintern is the duty
of Russians,a question of their honour and life. There
must be Russian forces amongst the forces fighting against
the army of the Third International. I call upon all or-
ganizations of the All-Russia Fascist Union to begin the
formation of Liberation Detachments which,after the estab-
lishment of the first Russian National Government,will be
renamed the Regeneration Detachments - and to put them-
selves at the disposal of the Union,thus constituting the
basic cells for the formation of the future Russian Natio-
nal Army.

(2) The well-to-do section of emigrants should give the means
for the formation of these detachments,for the maintenance
of families of those who left for Russia and for the even-
tual transportation of these families to Russia. Local
Committees of Anti-Communist Struggle Fund and-where such
committees do not exist- chiefs of local organizations
will take upon themselves the task of collecting funds.
Those evading to contribute towards this cause will be
regarded as traitors of National Russia.

(3) The Anti-Communist Struggle Fund is renamed the Fund of
Liberation and Regeneration of Russia. The central Fund
will carry out,direct or through local committees,extra-
ordinary collections in all places where Russian emigrants
reside.All Russian emigrants will be suggested to contri-
bute not less than 1/10-th of their respective means and
to pay not less than 10% of their earnings or income dur-
ing the whole duration of the war. Members of national-
revolutionary organizations actively participating in the
liberation work are exempted from these contributions.

( 4) All Fascists will prepare means in order to be able to
proceed to their respective places of appointment in Rus-
sia.

(5) All Fascists will refresh in their memory and think over
the "Plan of Fascist Construction in Russia" distributed
together with orders and,in parts, published in the "Na-
tion".

(6) Combatants! Russian National Revolution is in progress.
No retreat is possible now. Russia will perish or be ours
and resurrected to new life and new glory.
Glory to Russia!

Follows a declaration consisting of 12
paragraphs. In the first two paragraphs

由N.I.科尔加诺夫（N.I.KORGANOFF）先生编辑出版，地址：西华德路409号（East Seward Road）。

俄罗斯国家革命正在进行中

我们必须参与其中

全俄法西斯联盟

第13号命令

(1) 欧洲所有国家都起来斗争反对犹太共产国际。这场战争首先是我们的俄罗斯战争，摧毁共产国际是俄罗斯人的责任，关乎他们的荣誉和生命。在反对第三国际军队的战斗力量中，必须有俄罗斯力量。我呼吁全俄法西斯联盟的所有组织开始组建“解放分队”，在第一个俄罗斯国家政府成立后，这些分队将更名为“复兴分队”，并将自己置于联盟的支配之下，从而构成未来俄罗斯国家军队组建的基本细胞。

(2) 侨民中的富裕阶层应为组建这些分队、维持前往俄罗斯者的家属生活以及最终将这些家属运送至俄罗斯提供资金。反共斗争基金的地方委员会，以及在没有此类委员会的地方，地方组织的负责人，将承担筹集资金的任务。那些逃避为此事业捐款的人将被视为民族俄罗斯的叛徒。

(3) 反共斗争基金更名为“俄罗斯解放与复兴基金”。中央基金将在所有俄罗斯侨民居住地，直接或通过地方委员会进行特别募捐。建议所有俄罗斯侨民捐献不少于其各自资产的十分之一，并在整个战争期间支付不少于其收入或薪金的10%。积极参与解放工作的国家革命组织成员免除这些捐款。

(4) 所有法西斯主义者应准备手段，以便能够前往其在俄罗斯的各自任命地点。

(5) 所有法西斯主义者应重温并思考随命令分发的、并在《民族》（Nation）报刊上部分刊登的“俄罗斯法西斯建设计划”。

(6) 战士们！俄罗斯国家革命正在进行中。现在已无退路可言。俄罗斯要么灭亡，要么属于我们并复活获得新生和新荣耀。
俄罗斯万岁！

随后是一份由12个段落组成的声明。在前两段中

pages.en:
it is stated that the All-Russia Fascist Union wel-
comes National-Socialist Germany who started the
great campaign against the Jewish Comintern, and an
appeal is addressed to all peoples to participate in
the liquidation of the Red Jewish peril. The remain-
ing eight paragraphs deal with the ideology ,organi-
zation and tactics of the party.

VICTORY OR DEATH!    COMMUNISM OR FASCISM!    NOW OR
NEVER!
GLORY TO RUSSIA!

July 13,1941
Shanghai.

胜利或死亡！    共产主义或法西斯主义！    机不可失，时不再来！
俄罗斯万岁！

上海。

NOBODY IS KEEPING YOU. .......
Volunteers for the Red Army leaving Shanghai.

group of about 200 volunteers from amongst the local
Soviet youth and the Repatriation Union will be leaving Shanghai
for the U.S.S.R. by the first Soviet boat bound for Vladivostok.
This group applied through proper Soviet Channels for permission
to join the Red Army. A reply has now been received to the effect
that the permission has been granted and that the group in question
will be sent to Vladivostok.

Together with the volunteers are leaving two Soviet citizens
who are medical practitioners by profession and who also have
offered their services to Russia's hangmen.

We cannot but welcome the departure of volunteers for the
Red Army from amongst Russian emigrants, as in the majority of
cases members of the Repatriation Union and pro-Soviet youth
engage in agitation in favour of the U.S.S.R. only because they
have no knowledge of that country.

Once in the U.S.S.R. they will soon understand that the
communists care not for the interests of Motherland, but only
for the interests of the International and the party of oppressors.

A short stay in the U.S.S.R. will cure these "volunteers"
for ever from the effects of the red intoxication.

It is reported that amongst the volunteers are :
V. BROSDOFF, N. SVETLOFF-SVINYIN, N. SHCHGOLKOFF and others.

Translator's note:
Enquiries at the Repatriation Union, 105
Love Lane, show that there is no truth in the above report.

.........................
D.. I..
6-7-41.

译自1941年7月6日俄文报纸《俄罗斯时报》（Russian Times）上发表的一篇文章。由俄罗斯时报出版公司出版，地址：西华德路409号。编辑 - C.V.波波夫（C.V.Popoff）。

没人拦着你 ____ 
离开上海参加红军的志愿者。

一群约200名志愿者，来自当地的苏联青年和归国联盟，将乘坐第一艘驶往符拉迪沃斯托克（海参崴）的苏联船只离开上海前往苏联。该群体已通过适当的苏联渠道申请加入红军。现已收到回复，准许加入，所述群体将被送往符拉迪沃斯托克。

与志愿者同行的还有两名苏联公民，他们是职业医生，也都主动为俄罗斯的刽子手提供服务。

我们不得不欢迎俄罗斯侨民中参加红军的志愿者离去，因为在大多数情况下，归国联盟成员和亲苏青年之所以从事有利于苏联的宣传鼓动，仅仅是因为他们对该国缺乏了解。

一旦进入苏联，他们很快就会明白，共产党人关心的不是祖国的利益，而只是国际和压迫者政党的利益。

在苏联的短暂停留将永远治愈这些“志愿者”的红色狂热症。

据报道，志愿者中包括：
V. 布罗斯多夫（V. BROSDOFF）、N. 斯韦特洛夫-斯维宁（N. SVETLOFF-SVINYIN）、N. 什乔尔戈科夫（N. SHCHGOLKOFF）等人。

Translation of an extract from an editorial which appeared
in Russian newspaper "The Russian Times" on 4-7-41. Publish-
ed by the "Russian Times Publishing Co", 409 East Seward.
Road. Editor - Mr. C.V. Popoff.

THE RECKONING-DAY HAS ARRIVED

Commenting on the progress of th Soviet-German war
the newspaper expresses the opinion that final defeat of the
Red Army is not far away. No other outcome of the war can be
expected and a defeat of the Red Army will be fatal to the
Communist regime.

"The Red Army is dispersing and the Soviet govern-
ment shatters. The sooner it collapses the better for Rus-
sia. The later national revolution breaks out, the worse will
be the consequences of the present defeat of the U.S.S.R.
Only national revolution and National Russian Government will
be able to secure honourable peace.

Then the way will be open towards a military union
with Germany in the West and with Japan in the East followed
by victorious war against world democracy"

5-7-41.
pages.zh:
副本。

译自1941年7月4日俄文报纸《俄罗斯时报》上发表的一篇社论摘录。由“俄罗斯时报出版公司”出版，地址：西华德路409号。编辑 - C.V.波波夫先生。

清算之日已到

该报在评论苏德战争的进展时表示认为，红军的最终失败为期不远。战争不会有其他结果，红军的失败对共产主义政权将是致命的。

“红军正在溃散，苏联政府正在瓦解。它崩溃得越快，对俄罗斯越好。民族革命爆发得越晚，苏联目前失败的后果就越严重。只有民族革命和俄罗斯国家政府才能确保体面的和平。

此后，通往在西方与德国、在东方与日本建立军事联盟的道路将敞开，随之而来的是 against 世界民主的胜利战争”

1941年7月5日。

R. Bitker and B. Topas, two prominent personages

to the efforts of the IMPERIAL JAPANESE ARMY to stop the
contraband supply of arms to the Chungking Government and
Chinese red army, against whom National Japan and China have
been struggling for the past three years.

local Jewry have thrown off their masks and once more proved
the fact that there is no such thing as Russian, German or
Hungarian Jewry, that the interests of the countries who

日俄战争之后，第一位俄国法西斯主义者P.A.斯托雷平（P.A. Stolypin）和日本伟大的政治家伊藤伯爵（Count Ito）正准备缔结俄日紧密同盟。然而，“卡哈尔”（Kagal）的黑暗势力摧毁了这一计划：斯托雷平被一名名叫博格罗夫（Bogroff）的犹太人刺杀，而伊藤伯爵则被一名身份不明的朝鲜狂热分子刺杀——两人均受世界共济会的指使行事。

1914年的世界大战是由英国挑起的，其背后是犹太人和共济会。由尼古拉二世皇帝在比约克（Bjorke）缔结的俄、法、德同盟，由于以维特伯爵（Count Witte）为首的俄国共济会员的阴谋而被废除。挑起战争的英国直到最后一刻都保持着不确定的态度，以便使德国卷入对俄国的战争。当胜利似乎可能时，二月革命爆发了，现已查明，这是由英国驻圣彼得堡大使布坎南（Buchanan）和世界犹太人煽动的。他们想要毁灭俄国并削弱德国。他们想要剥夺俄国拥有达达尼尔海峡——黑海钥匙的权利。在此期间

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Section 1, Special Branch.
REPORT
No. S. B. D. ____
Date JULY 4, 1940.

Subject ......... Anti-Semitic plot in Shanghai.

Made by. D.S.I. Prokopiev. Forwarded by. Capt. J. Wilson.

〔此处转录不清：Commr. of Police / Sir: / Information / (Signature) / (S. Br.)〕

According to an unconfirmed report, a certain
group of local Russians of Fascist tendencies intend to
stage a pogrom of an anti-Jewish or anti-Semitic
character in connection with the recent "China Press" in-
terview with leaders of the local Jewish community re-
garding the alleged readiness of Russian Jews in the
Far East to fight on the side of Great Britain. Infor-
mation to hand indicates that "in order to counteract
the Jewish move" the group in question will approach
the local Nazi and Italian Fascist organizations with an
offer to organize a Russian Fascist detachment for local
service in the interests of the Axis powers.

Even if the above report proves to be correct,
all this seems to be nothing but an attempt to create an
agitation, possibly, with the assistance of individual
members of local Nazi and Italian Fascist groups. It
would also appear that in view of the present state of
affairs in the Far East a section of the local Jewish
community regard the statement made to the "China Press"
by Messrs B.A. Topas and R. Bitker as a tactical blunder.
At least Mr. Topas thought it necessary to make another
statement to the "Shanghai Zaria" (translation attached)
in which his efforts are apparent to soften the effects
of the interview published in the "China Press".

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE / 5 JULY 1940）

DATE 4/7/40

A. Prokopiev
D. S. I.

D. C. (Special Branch).

JUN 2 - '

Jews Here Ready To Fight
For Allies, Leaders Say

News that a Jewish Army may be formed to fight in Allied ranks caused feelings to run high in the local Russian-Jewish colony yesterday. Community leaders told THE CHINA PRESS that Jews of military age in China will enlist at once if Britain approves the offer made by the Zionist Federation of Great Britain and Ireland.

It was pointed out that members of the local branch of the Brith Trumpeldor, world-wide Jewish body subsidiary to the New Zionist Party, have received military training for years, and that there are at least 1,000 Russian Jews in China who could be sent to Europe on funds raised by Far Eastern Jewry.

"Civilization is at stake!" Mr. B. Topas, head of the Shanghai branch of the Old Zionist Organization, declared. "It is better that we die like men than live in persecution," he added, referring to news that widespread arrests of Jews have been launched in Italy.

"We Will Fight"

Mr. R. Bitker, leader of the New Zionist Party in Shanghai, an out-growth of the old organization, declared that Jews in China will "surely join, at once."

Both leaders expressed distress at news of arrests of Jews in Italy. "What can I say? It is very sad," was the comment of Mr. Bitker, while Mr. Topas declared that "We Jews are used to persecution."

"We have suffered for 3,000 years," he continued. "We have lost half our number in Central Europe, for although physically they may still be alive, morally they are dead; and most of them will not be heard from again."

"If we are given the chance, we will fight. But we will be fighting not for ourselves alone; because if civilization is allowed to collapse, it will not be only the Jews who will suffer—everybody will be in the same boat."

"England Will Win!"

"Nobody has had any concern for our interests in the past," Mr. Topas went on, "so that we will not be fighting for England. But we have learned that wherever English influence is strongest, all people are given an equal chance to live, and that is why Jewish sympathies today are on the side of England.

"And England will win!" he exclaimed. "Things may seem to look black now, but one year from today they will look quite different."

Meanwhile, as the whole Russian Jewish community was stirred at prospects of the formation of a Jewish Army, excitement ran highest among members of the Brith Trumpeldor organization, which trains young men and women on a semi-military pattern for eventual migration to Palestine.

Many young Russian Jews here are enrolled in the body, whose aim is getting back Palestine as the Jewish national home at all costs, it was pointed out.

Get War Training

As soon as a member reaches the age of 18, he automatically joins the Jewish Company of the Shanghai Volunteer Corps, and receives military training both with the Corps and at weekly meetings of the Brith Trumpeldor, it was stated.

The men were thus said to be acquainted with strict discipline and the use of rifles, and needed very little elementary military training for service overseas.

Young women of the Brith Trumpeldor, it was revealed, receive training in first aid, cooking and other spheres of knowledge that would enable them to lead a life of pioneers when, as they confidently hope, they will finally be allowed to enter Palestine.

6月2日 - '

此处犹太人准备为盟军作战，领袖称

昨日，有关可能组建犹太军队加入盟军行列参战的消息，在当地俄裔犹太社群中引起了强烈反响。社区领袖告诉《字林西报》，如果英国批准大不列颠及爱尔兰犹太复国主义联合会提出的提议，中国境内适龄犹太男子将立即入伍。

有人指出，作为新犹太复国党附属的全球性犹太组织“布里特·特朗普尔多尔”（Brith Trumpeldor）当地分支的成员，多年来一直接受军事训练，并且在中国至少有1000名俄国犹太人，可以通过远东犹太人筹集的资金派往欧洲。

“文明危在旦夕！”老犹太复国主义组织上海分会负责人B.托帕斯先生宣称。“与其生活在迫害中，不如像男子汉一样死去，”他补充道，指的是意大利已展开大规模逮捕犹太人的消息。

“我们将战斗”

新犹太复国党上海领导人、由旧组织发展而来的R.比特克先生宣布，在华犹太人将“肯定立即加入”。

两位领导人都对意大利逮捕犹太人的消息表示悲痛。“我能说什么呢？非常令人难过，”比特克先生评论道，而托帕斯先生则宣称：“我们犹太人习惯了迫害。”

“我们已经受苦三千年，”他继续说道。“我们在中欧失去了一半的人口，因为虽然他们在肉体上可能还活着，但在精神上已经死亡；而且大多数人将不再有任何音讯。”

“如果有机会，我们将战斗。但我们不仅仅是为自己而战；因为如果允许文明崩溃，遭受苦难的将不仅仅是犹太人——所有人都将同舟共济。”

“英国必胜！”

“过去没有人关心过我们的利益，”托帕斯先生接着说，“所以我们不是为了英国而战。但我们了解到，在英国影响力最强的地方，所有人都享有平等的生存机会，这就是为什么今天犹太人的同情心偏向英国。

“英国必胜！”他惊呼道。“现在情况看起来可能很糟糕，但一年后的今天，情况将会截然不同。”

与此同时，随着整个俄裔犹太社群因组建犹太军队的前景而激动不已，“布里特·特朗普尔多尔”组织的成员情绪最为高涨，该组织以半军事化模式培训青年男女，以便最终移民巴勒斯坦。

有人指出，这里许多年轻的俄国犹太人都加入了该组织，其目标是不惜一切代价夺回巴勒斯坦作为犹太民族的家园。

接受战争训练

据悉，成员一旦年满18岁，就会自动加入上海万国商团的犹太连队，并在商团以及“布里特·特朗普尔多尔”的周会上接受军事训练。

据说，这些人因此熟悉严格的纪律和步枪的使用，只需很少的基础军事训练即可在海外服役。

据透露，“布里特·特朗普尔多尔”的年轻女性接受急救、烹饪和其他领域知识的培训，使她们能够在最终获准进入巴勒斯坦时（她们对此充满希望），过上拓荒者的生活。
